name: Computational Thinking & Introduction to Computing
summary: A first look at how computers represent information, run programs and talk to each other, and at the problem-solving habits (decomposition, abstraction, algorithms) behind all of computer science.

topics.name: What computer science is: problems, algorithms and computation
Decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction and algorithm design
Expressing algorithms with flowcharts and pseudocode
Representing text, images, sound and video as data
Hardware basics: CPU, memory, storage and input/output
Software layers: operating systems, applications and programming languages
How the Internet and the Web work: packets, IP addresses, DNS and HTTP
Everyday algorithms: searching, sorting and comparing their efficiency
Limits of computation: problems computers cannot solve (intuition)
Data, privacy and personal cybersecurity basics
A first program in a block-based language (Scratch)
